notes.title: New game announcment - Mushroom Picnic Party!
notes.content:
Howdy!

We are thrilled to announce our new lil cozy game! It’s all about finding cute mushrooms and helping friendly villagers with preparation for a picnic party!



[h1][b]Mushroom Picnic Party[/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=XNVUye1raCw;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tons of little mushrooms to find!
[*] Creative puzzles
[*] Secrets
[*] Cozy and wholesome vibes
[/list]

If you are interested please consider adding it to your wishlist! <3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469280

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Community & Accessibility
notes.content:
Howdy!


We have a big update for you with things that you asked for and more! 


You can now get cool chicken [b]achievements[/b]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41618505/3f26f492487a65c147382785a006c791380804ce.gif[/img]
Note: If you've already finished the game, just launch it and all the achievements will update themselves using your save game.


[b]Controls rebinding[/b] for keyboard and controllers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41618505/a4c856b65812ad9e5c8dfc0bf30d9fceebc281ea.jpg[/img]


[b]Steam trading cards[/b] and more! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41618505/2a59ffd39636492cfd7991b6d2450cbd4c2370d0.jpg[/img]

We prepared a set of 6 steam standing cards, badges, emotes, and background art to unlock during the play through.


[b]Rich presence[/b]. So all of your friends will know where you are in the Chicken Journey!


[u]We also fix some bugs:[/u]
[list]
[*] Disappearing platforms in the swamps
[*] Yarn thread corner-cases
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5730
notes.content:
We have a new update for you today!

The biggest thing are [b]German[/b] and [b]Latin American Spanish[/b] localizations, prepared by our wonderful and very professional volunteers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41618505/2dced1b5fd146a9899b5270551821211ca0ceb16.jpg[/img]

Here's a full list of changes:

[u]Additions:[/u]
- Add German and Latin American Spanish localizations
- Add up to 4 save slots with progress percent indicator on each one
- Add optional quests section in quest log
- Add special thanks to credits

[u]Bug fixes:[/u]
- Fix saving during water level change in Swamp Temple
- Fix handling in-game menu when it's under pause menu
- Fix multiple localization issues
- Fix yarn getting stuck inside the wall

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5634
notes.content:
After a week since the release of Chicken Journey we finally found some time to just sit down and fix as many issues as you and us could find. Here's a list of all the changes coming with build 1.0.5634.

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- Fixed gears in Swamp Temple killing player on spawn from a distance
- Fixed checkpoints locations in Mosquito Swamps
- Fixed collision blocking of Johnny in Mosquito Swamps
- Added puzzle blocking progress early, if Johnny got ignored on Mosquito Swamps
- Fixed bridge collision in Mushroom Cave
- Fixed yarn thread unwinding in Wardrobe
- Fixed Taylor checking for Yarn in player's inventory
- Fixed yarn pickup when left next to exit
- Fixed big yarn ball getting stack on a corner of a wall
- Fixed collision between yarn thread and some other objects on the level
- Fixed rendering of yarn thread, lines, and few FX in pixelated aesthetic
- Fixed marking elevator quest as finished
- Fixed blocking the game when opening pause menu with inventory selector present
- Fixed multiple camera issues during transitions
- Fixed sluggish movement on ladders
- Fixed visibility of collectible hints in multiple places
- Fixed localization fallback to English if translation to chosen language is missing
- Added checkpoints at Pool Party

[u]Accessibility features:[/u]
- Added Tap-on-Hold accessibility feature
- Released the system cursor

[u]And we left the best for last:[/u]

[b]WE ADDED AN OPTION TO PUT ON HATS FROM THE INVENTORY!!![/b]

We hope you'll have us much fun, playing Chicken Journey, as we had making it :)
(But please, sleep more the we did ^^)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
First off, thank you so much for all the love you've shown Chicken Journey on the release day! We have a hotfix ready for you:

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- Fixed many ways you could get blocked in the Temple. If you did suffer a blocking issue, you should now be able to continue your game where you left off.
- Fixed a blocked passage in the mosquito-infested part of the Swamps.
- Fixed an unintended passage in the mosquito-infested part of the Swamps. If you went down to talk to Johnny, you could be suffering from a broken save file. You can contact us for help at support@loonyware.com.
- Fixed multiple missing or misplaced animations. If you see Johnny wearing a winter hat on a warm sunny day, please contact us immediately.

[u]Known issues:[/u]
- There could be some unpixelated graphics visible in the game. We are working on fixing this promptly.



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Chicken Journey demo is out now!
notes.content:
Howdy!

We are pleased to announce that during the Tiny Teams Steam festival you will be able to play the Chicken Journey demo for the first time ever!

Help friendly townsfolk with their problems and investigate these weird sounds from the well! 
 

The Chicken Journey demo is available in 13 languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish (European)
[*] Spanish (Latin American)
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Dutch
[*] Hungarian
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese Simplified
[*] Chinese Traditional
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Hindi
[/list]


We hope you'll enjoy the demo! If you will, please wishlist, so you're the first to know when there's any news.

We also prepared a quick survey you can take after playing the demo, so please consider doing so if you have time! It will help us a lot :)
